# protocol

```go
import "github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/protocol"
```

Package protocol contains all the abstractions needed to work with the server \- client opcodes defined here: https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/docs/wiki/Protocol

## Index

- [type Bytefy](<#type-bytefy>)
- [type Package](<#type-package>)


## type [Bytefy](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/protocol/init.go#L13-L16>)

Is the interface that has to be implemented by the different opcode implementations\.

```go
type Bytefy interface {
    // Will return the by the protocol defined opcode representations.
    Bytes() Package
}
```

## type [Package](<https://github.zhaw.ch/raycasters/server/blob/master/protocol/init.go#L10>)

Package is a readability abstraction\. Used for clearer handling of the data packages that are received from or are send to the client\.

```go
type Package = []byte
```
